data.content_ref: inline:Relation Kind: Reduction (Science Reduces to Evolutionary Epistemology). The problem asserts a reduction relation where all norms of scientific preference are reducible to biological fitness conditions of the cognitive agent; 'rationality' is simply the name for cognitive strategies that enhanced ancestral survival. Refuted If: It is shown that scientific methods frequently prescribe actions (e.g., accepting counter-intuitive theories) that reduce individual biological fitness or reproductive success, proving that scientific norms cannot be reduced to biological imperatives.
